en: [You have committed a love for Aya Shameimaru...]
[With a drill and a screwdriver, you install the cover onto the vent. In hindsight, you probably should've turned the fan off first.]

''Much appreciated mate. I don't offer smithy services to non-Rijikans as I've got enough on my hands already. If ya' got your own workshop, these'll be of good use.
Consulting with local spiritual advisors and following the proper rites has cleansed the ring of its otherworldly power, leaving behind a mere residual force.
[You have committed a love for Kogasa Tatara...]
Thank you for helping, dearie. You can have our old fridge, too. You ought to keep foods stored if you're not going to eat them immediately, okay?
[This particular ship is hundreds of years old and was once used by the Royal Australian Navy before their dissolution as a space power.]
[Many militaries of Earth during the Golden Trail-era did not form a new department for 'spacecraft' and instead relegated void navies to their respective Navy or Airforce branches.]

[The Navy branches of many nations would transition almost entirely to voidcraft as any 'Home Guard' branches would be given the duty of maintaining sea-based navies along with new Land-Air-Sea sub-branches for the growing bureaucracy of space.]
[This type of vessel utilizes a hardpoint system that was popular during the Golden Trail-era, where very small but potent turrets would be hidden under the hull when out of combat.]
[An autocannon has been added to the front, making it now possible to use anti-orbital rounds on ground targets.]
